title: Diagnosis Record Payload
$comment: Repository-authoritative implementation schema (ticket #54, SPEC-306 section 7). The spec package has no draft schema document for the diagnosis payload — this document IS the registry entry (ruling D posture, same as ticket #50's metric-sample schema): the registry branch in domain/observation/registry.py enforces exactly the obligations below (required fields + vocabularies; unknown additional keys stay tolerated at the envelope layer per SPEC-301 section 8). Two payload variants share this document: raised/updated carry the full candidate shape; cleared carries only diagnosis_id + rule_id + the clear reason. confidence is the diagnosis THREE-tier static declaration (SPEC-307 section 3) — a different axis from the observation ConfidenceKind provenance vocabulary; the two must never be conflated (registry refuses the four-value axis here).

journal_seq.description: Per-session journal_seq of the committed observation record (SPEC-306 section 6).

event_type.description: Registered SPEC-301 event type of the referenced record.

diagnosis_id.description: uuid4 opaque identity (ADR-0006 decision 3); raised mints it, updated keeps it.

rule_version.description: SPEC-307 section 7 traceability: the rule version rides the payload and the diagnoses row.

confidence.description: Static three-tier rule declaration (SPEC-307 section 3) — the engine computes no score and never claims a probability (SPEC-003 section 2.6).

affected_node_ids.description: Semantic node slugs (ADR-0006 decision 3) as plain strings — the diagnosis domain does not import domain.topology.

evidence_anchor.description: TWO states (SPEC-306 section 6 MVP + SPEC-306 Phase 2 patch revision, ticket #138): the MVP flat triple {artifact_id, pid, packet_index}, or the Phase 2 {artifact_id, locator} — the evidence event's payload locator fields verbatim (no fabricated pid/packet_index). Exactly one state holds.

artifact_id.description: Resolves through the SPEC-502 artifacts table to the SPEC-503 physical file (SPEC-306 section 6 chain terminus).

packet_index.description: Position in the ADR-0007 item 4 shared packet-order frame (baseline and faulted share one index space — same index, same slot).

artifact_id.description: Resolves through the SPEC-502 artifacts table to the SPEC-503 physical file (SPEC-306 section 6 chain terminus) — the Phase 2 reference chain: the mutation-log artifact for biss.*, the run's received-leg Inner TS artifact for t2mi.*/bbframe.*.

locator.description: The evidence event's payload locator fields verbatim (SPEC-306 Phase 2 anchor-chain table: t2mi.plp_mismatch → expected_plp/actual_plp/business_absent_evidence; bbframe.recovery_failed → first_failed_frame_index/failure_count; biss.descramble_failed → failed_indices_sample/pid_scope).

reason.description: The clear cause (SPEC-306 section 7: symptom gone, e.g. after regeneration without the symptom).
